## Highlights

- Establish a current-only prelaunch baseline: initialize application schema 24 directly, preserve valid current state and daemon identity, and refuse obsolete, foreign, partial or malformed stores with explicit reset guidance. No historical conversion or automatic deletion.
- Use current desktop preferences without Fyne import or transition output, one complete metrics format 4 and current qualification evidence revision 2. The incompatible removals select v2.0.0; command names, HTTP /api/v1 and valid current formats stay unchanged.
- Keep deterministic desktop one-off previews across ordinary and repeated-hour dates, and retain bounded metrics preflight retries with actionable underlying lock diagnostics (#409/#410).
- Review the sourced capability comparison with existing vendor edition/preview/unknown qualifiers. Clustered execution remains explicitly owner-deferred; SQLite 1.60.1/libc 1.77.1 remain selected while #400/#404 are unresolved.
- Original Windows runtime/prerequisite and inspection causes remain unconfirmed in [#355](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/issues/355) and [#356](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/issues/356). Attended native observations remain untested under the standing native-testing waiver; automated CI and artifact checks remain required.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v2.0.0/CHANGELOG.md#200---2026-10-31) for every change.
